Summary of last night's Tomodachi Life below, big things are happening, but also a historical moment with child birthing, familial bonds, and wholesomeness. You can follow me on Twitter/X for daily summaries after every stream! ↓↓↓↓　
===
Summary：
A baby named Azela (anak Zeta Kaela aka Zeta and Kaela's kid) was born safely. Inheriting her parents' traits, she is a wonderful nonchalant Achiever that is ready to take on the world! Seriously, even the gods are smitten with her charisma and talent... Eurienesia's children population are growing, and everyone is excited about whatt marvels the youth can bring to the island.
However, at what cost? One of the anomalies disappears without a trace, getting mixed feedback from the Watchers. Since the anomalies prove to be repelling the island's curse, what will change after today? So far, there are four anomalies left still looking in the corners of the island, detached from the main residential area, socializing with each other and showing non-violent tendencies. One of them makes an appearance in the MNN Broadcasting room, and whether this is a danger or not is currently under discussion.
Kaela, being a dad of a newly born baby, expresses peculiar interest in moving together with Bijou. After much thought, it was decided that Bijou is going to live together and move to Zeta and Kaela (third time's the charm)'s space. At present, it's a husband-wife household, with one biological child and one adopted child. May they be happy always. Tension is normally high after marriage and the birth of a new child, as proven with Reine and Iofi's household in the past, but the gods believe it's a hurdle that can be overcome.
Her previous request of living together with Kobo was curbed; while it was interesting to have holoh3ro in the same house, Kobo is the needed glue for Subaru and Risu's relationship before the two decide to have a biological child of their own.
Reyfi, Reine and Iofi's child, shows signs of being a picky eater and dresser. It's suspected that it's because the gods rejected her request of adding ugly as fudge greeneries in the island, and more investigation will be conducted.
Anya and Moona have been sweethearts for six days, so just get married already.
Lui, now sharing mutual feelings with Kiara, expresses her desire to live with Kiara, and now she is back in the Reine Iofi household (married with three kids). If they become a couple, get married, and have children, this house will host two big families. Exciting to think about. Hopefully Kiara stops exclusively yearning and makes a move.
Elizabeth was stripped from her string bean status, and she is now wearing matching dresses with Nerissa the therapist, their relationship stay platonic, especially with Nerissa dating Fuwawa, but they are not married yet, so anything can happen.
Another big news worth mentioning is that after the lingering worries regarding amnesia in siblings, a cure has been found! It seems that moving together with your sibling brings back the lost memories. Fuwawa and Mococo move in together to a new house, and realize they are sisters all along. A heartwarming moment, as they continue to show sisterly love in their shared living space "the grand bauhaus".
Mori Calliope, after spending a lot of time with Gigi, one day realizes that she has feelings for the latter. The two can still be seen hanging out together as friends, and they even begin to match outfits, but will this love bear fruit? Only one way to find out...
The ferris wheel continue to be a cursed place for confessions, as Kronii rejected HopeRyS outright. A quick solo Mediterranean trip healed the latter, so hopefully everything will be fine. The time warden is currently in love with the big cat, and while the big cat thinks of her as a great friend, she lets Kronii keep all her skincare in Raora's fridge, so the gods hope for another romance to go well.
Speaking of HopeRyS, her other half IRySoEvil starts calling her eggRyS instead. These two are related, so just like FuwaMoco, hopefully they realize it one day. Speaking of the IRySes, IRySoEvil isn't doing so hot as well, with her continuously yearning for Fuwawa, who is currently taken by Nerissa.
Cecilia bonds with Kronii about loving yourself, and it seems to work. With a lot of people ( 31 "people") in the island, even simple interactions like this mean a lot. Marine becomes good friends with Lui too, and the both of them can be seen reading or chatting at the beach often.
Nerissa thinks all the food the gods give her smell like hotpot. Everyone in general seems to develop more verbal tics and catchphrases lately. The gods are pleased.

Will more wholesome romance happen? Or will more convoluted drama happen instead? Who will be the next resident of the island? State your wishes below.

Hello Zecretaries I hope you’re doing well ^o^ !!
Not really a huge announcement or anything but I have something to talk about~! This will be my mission report or essay of this week haha

I made a tweet about this topic long ago maybe like a few months ago but I feel like some people haven't seen it so I’ll make a new longer post here. This will be my last post on this matter. 

Belakangan ini aku sudah berhati-hati sebenarnya kalau ngejoke apalagi dark jokes. Kebetulan banget clips ku yang populer tuh pas kebetulan aku lagi nyatir 😭 aku gak pengen orang2 baru yang dateng jadi malah mikir “lah ni orang kerjanya nyatir doang ya?” padahal paling cuma sekali dua kali . Gak sepanjang stream aku kerjaannya roasting orang guys, dan kadang zecretary dan aku saling roasting satu sama lain karena jatuhnya “banter” bolak balik atau jadi momen lucu interaktif aja

Aku yakin banyak Zecretary yang sebenarnya gak masalah (malah suka di roasting misalnya), tapi mungkin ada juga yang beneran merasa tersinggung.

Disini aku ingin minta maaf apabila ada yang pernah merasa tersinggung karena jokes aku, terutama apabila menyangkut ortu ya karena mungkin ada yang anggap tidak sopan. Saat bikin joke sperti itu pikiran ku kosong, entah itu lagi fokus baca chat/stream/gaming (tidak ada niat sama sekali dipikiranku yang sengaja ingin meledek sekelompok orang tertentu).  Ini jadi pembelajaran buat aku untuk berhati-hati lagi. Sejak saat itu gak pernah lho sebenarnya ku lakukan lagi, tapi mungkin itu udah terlanjur berbekas di pikiran orang.

Untuk jokes-jokes lainnya yang lebih random, aku udah berusaha milah milih perkataan dan nambahin kata “canda” di akhir, walaupun belum kebiasaan dan masih sering lupa. Aku juga mau nanya karena menurutku ini lucu. Kalau misalnya ada yang komen “Mulut zeta bau” aku ngerasa komennya lucu sih lalu aku jawab “pantat mu bau, bau bawang”. Ini nyatir juga kah? Roasting yang berlebihan kah?🤔

Aku gak mau karena banter malah dicap sebagai “si tukang penyatir paling pedes” misalnya. Bukan nyatirnya yang bikin aku seneng padahal, sebenernya aku senang liat reaksi penonton yg juga senang.  I’m a streamer who likes to banter with my viewers, not a streamer who likes to roast my viewers. 

Aku membuat post ini bukan berarti artinya aku akan berhenti nge joke ya guys, aku akan lebih milih2 aja kalo lagi kalau nge joke, yang lucu tapi ga terlalu dark bgt🫡 so dont worry about me! 

Note: Semua orang pasti responnya berbeda, ada yang suka2 lucu2an aja, lalu di satu sisi ada yang tersinggung. Kita gak bisa nge judge mereka yang merasa tersinggung karena mereka juga manusia yang punya perasaan. Itu valid. Jangan ada perdebatan ya guys antara "kok kamu sensitif bgt sih?" VS "hah kek gt dibilang lucu?" Pasti akan ada orang yang merasa ok dan merasa tidak ok. Zecretary, kalian gak perlu bela aku juga, aku meminta maaf karena atas keinginan sendiri dan karena ingin belajar menjadi lebih baik lagi. Thank you udah dengerin yaa

It wasn’t in my intention to offend anyone with my jokes, I only thought about entertainment and how to make my streams funnier. I also apologize if my jokes like "yo mom" jokes or the “dad went to get milk and never came back” offended anyone😰 I thought it was a funny meme and I wasn’t making that joke to offend anyone who does not have a dad figure

I will still be joking around but I won’t be mentioning sensitive topics. Do not worry! I'm not gonna be losing my sense of humor  after this lol I will probably still be doing dark jokes here and there but I KNOW MY LIMITS. Certain topics are off limits. 

People will always have different opinions on what is funny and what is not. There will be people who like it, and people who dislike it. Obviously I cannot please everyone. You don't need to watch my stream if it bothers you. Again, this is just me clarifying things and being honest with you guys

PS: There’s probably gonna be people saying “dont worry zeta!” Thank you but I’m not worrying about it neither am I overthinking, I'm just clarifying things. Besides, it wouldn’t hurt to make my streams an even more better place for those who support me. I’m grateful that I have Zecretary, mchan, hololive supporting me. I will continue to work hard!💪|

I'm open to constructive criticism from Zecretary. However, I am going to ignore baseless hate. You guys should ignore those types too. Remember: RBI ( Report, block, ignore )
